userStories.title: Define expect/actual SpeechRecognizer interface
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a common interface for speech recognition so that the UI layer calls platform-agnostic code.
acceptanceCriteria: expect class SpeechRecognizer in commonMain with startListening(locale: String), stopListening(), release(), and results: Flow<SpeechResult> where SpeechResult is a sealed class with Partial(text: String), Final(text: String), Error(message: String)
Stub actual class SpeechRecognizer in webMain that emits SpeechResult.Error("unsupported") immediately
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Android SpeechRecognizer actual implementation
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Android actual using android.speech.SpeechRecognizer so that voice input works on Android.
acceptanceCriteria: actual class SpeechRecognizer in androidMain wraps android.speech.SpeechRecognizer
RECORD_AUDIO permission declared in AndroidManifest.xml
startListening() creates a RecognitionListener that emits SpeechResult.Partial on partial results and SpeechResult.Final on onResults()
Emits SpeechResult.Error on permission denial or onError() callback
release() calls destroy() on the underlying android.speech.SpeechRecognizer
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: iOS SpeechRecognizer actual implementation
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the iOS actual using the Speech framework so that voice input works on iOS.
acceptanceCriteria: actual class SpeechRecognizer in iosMain uses SFSpeechRecognizer + SFSpeechAudioBufferRecognitionRequest + AVAudioEngine
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription and NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription added to iosApp/Info.plist
startListening() requests both permissions on first use; emits SpeechResult.Error if either is denied
Emits SpeechResult.Final when stopListening() is called and recognition completes
release() stops AVAudioEngine and cancels the active recognition task
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Android OcrReader actual implementation (ML Kit)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Android actual using ML Kit Text Recognition so that OCR works on Android.
acceptanceCriteria: Add com.google.mlkit:text-recognition to androidMain dependencies in libs.versions.toml and composeApp/build.gradle.kts
actual class OcrReader in androidMain with recognizeText() that converts ByteArray to InputImage via InputImage.fromByteArray()
Runs TextRecognition.getClient(TextRecognizerOptions.DEFAULT_OPTIONS).process(inputImage) and emits OcrResult.Success with the full extracted text (blocks joined by newline)
Emits OcrResult.Error if ML Kit processing fails
Uses on-device model only (TextRecognizerOptions.DEFAULT_OPTIONS, no cloud client)

userStories.title: iOS OcrReader actual implementation (Vision framework)

acceptanceCriteria: actual class OcrReader in iosMain with recognizeText() that converts ByteArray to UIImage via NSData, then to CGImage
Creates VNRecognizeTextRequest with recognitionLevel = .accurate
Runs VNImageRequestHandler(cgImage:) with the text request and emits OcrResult.Success with all recognized strings joined by newline
Emits OcrResult.Error if handler throws or no text is found
No extra dependency required (Vision is part of iOS SDK)
